title: Mode-conditioned Mirror coordinates for a shared Neural ODE vector field
hypothesis: For four 2D linear ODE modes generated by rotating one shared stable vector field, one learned base matrix plus one angle per mode reaches independent-field endpoint normalized RMSE within 10% at <=60% actual serialized bytes, with equal solver NFE and no higher stiffness ratio.
physical_object: one shared 2x2 linear vector field A
mirror_coordinate: one mode-specific 2D rotation angle, applying Q(m) A Q(m)^T

task.teacher: stable symmetric base matrix with fixed eigenvalues, conjugated by mode-specific rotations

development.selection_metric: lowest mean validation derivative normalized RMSE

success_gate: On each fresh world, Mirror RK4-16 endpoint normalized RMSE <=1.1x independent field, actual payload <=60% independent, same NFE, and no greater maximum stiffness ratio.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any registered quality/byte/stability threshold or a simpler gate/rank-one control dominates at comparable bytes.
boundaries: Teacher is generated by the same rotational Mirror family; aligned feasibility only.
Fixed-step RK4 solver cost; adaptive solver behavior not tested.
Linear 2D dynamics only; nonlinear Neural ODE capacity is unestablished.
